name: Slider
when: A reader sets one number along a range, on its own track or over a track a drawing draws, stepping between stops where a drawing has them
replaces: The native range inputs of the threat's rail, the neighbors' range, the marks' dusk, and the faces' time, beside the handle the coupling chart drew into its track

examples.name: Between Stops
examples.says: A drag follows the pointer, and an arrow key lands on the next stop past the value.
